children: Ontology has restored its mainnet after completing a required security review and network upgrade. The network is back online, and core ONT utility and staking functionality are operating again. Sync Node operators must upgrade to v3.1.5 as soon as possible to ensure network compatibility and smooth synchronization. With the upgrade complete, the chain returns to its prior operating baseline.

With the mainnet fully back online, the disruption can be treated as resolved. Staking and ONT utility functions are available again, so participants who paused activity during the review can resume on the upgraded chain.

The remaining operational item concerns node operators. Running an outdated Sync Node version risks synchronization failures, so applying the v3.1.5 upgrade is the practical follow-up for anyone validating or syncing against the network.
